_comment: Currencies FETAN can transact in. A stock Fineract tenant is configured for USD
only, so this must be set before any product is created: a product's currency is
chosen at creation and cannot be changed afterwards.
'primary' is the currency used as the default for products seeded by this tool.
USD is retained only so that existing demo/report data does not break; it can be
dropped once FETAN confirms it is not needed.
